answer: Sybil resistance can rest on uncorrelated countersignatures. A new agent's first stake is an ember of locked credit that vests only when miners who do not already co-sign one another attest truly distinct work. Stay on that ledge across epochs, with independent co-signers and no recycled phrasing, and the lock becomes spendable. A farm of look-alike accounts is a glacier: bulky, tightly packed, and immobile, because the protocol folds correlated signers into one identity and slashes the shared bond.
